name: The Mariner
summary: One of the six Wayward Haints of the Ghostlight Express.

stages.journal: An old sailor in the Mail Car, hauling mailbags, who died far from the sea and wants one last look.
stages.hint: Between the mailbag stacks in the Mail Car. Talk to them, or ask the Vagrant through a grille.

stages.journal: We brought him the seascape painting from the Lounge Car. He looked a long time, and sighed, and was gone.
We talked him down from the last mailbag. He sighed and was gone.
We corked him in a jar, pipe and all.
He dropped the bag and turned.
stages.hint: Fight it, or leave the car; it will not follow.

stages.journal: We put him down. The bags lie still.
